verses.25:77: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا

meaning: The root عبأ (ʿabāʾa) primarily means to pack, prepare, or arrange things, like goods or an army. It also refers to preparing and mixing perfumes.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
